mapper.select: SELECT o.value_date FROM tif_skgas_odin o WHERE o.index_id = #{indexId} AND o.index_div = 'F' AND o.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY o.value_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT u.value_month, u.index_value FROM (
SELECT o.value_month AS value_month, o.index_value AS index_value FROM tif_skgas_odin o WHERE o.index_id = #{indexId} AND o.index_div = 'F' AND o.del_yn = 'N' AND o.value_date = #{latestValueDate}
UNION
SELECT o.value_month AS value_month, o.index_value AS index_value FROM ( SELECT MAX(p.value_date) AS value_date, p.value_month AS value_month, p.index_id AS index_id FROM tif_skgas_odin p WHERE p.index_id = #{indexId} AND p.index_div = 'F' AND p.del_yn = 'N' AND p.value_month >= #{fromMonth} AND p.value_month < ( SELECT MIN(c.value_month) FROM tif_skgas_odin c WHERE c.index_id = #{indexId} AND c.index_div = 'F' AND c.del_yn = 'N' AND c.value_date = #{latestValueDate} ) GROUP BY p.value_month, p.index_id ) t JOIN tif_skgas_odin o ON o.value_date = t.value_date AND o.value_month = t.value_month AND o.index_id = t.index_id AND o.index_div = 'F' AND o.del_yn = 'N' ) u ORDER BY u.value_month ASC
